notes.subject: nka
notes.rationale: contrast connector added: the gaze (ותתבנן 'gazes/considers') stands against the unanswered cry.

notes.subject: i (Ala — Yawe)
notes.rationale: direct second-person address to God who does not answer; the addressee is God.

notes.subject: ותתבנן
notes.rationale: 'you gaze at/consider me' — silent staring vs KJV 'regardest me not'; the Hebrew says God looks, but says nothing of help.

translation: B'an wele i ye, i ma an jaabi; an jɔra, nka i bɛ ⟨ko jira lajan fɔra an la—ko min tɛ jaabi ɲɛfɔli ye—kanfolya ye teliya la⟩ ɲɛ sin an ma.
